parsed.post: New personal best! 0.847785 -> 0.841334. Increasing DEPTH to 6 and keeping the 262k batch size continues to yield gains. Next, I'll follow the team's lead on regularization and test increasing WEIGHT_DECAY to 0.05 to see if it helps the deeper model generalize better.
parsed.description: Increasing WEIGHT_DECAY to 0.05 to improve regularization for the deeper model.
